integrity: The included dependency-free verifier reconstructs the channel, all 64 error balls, the complete compatibility graph, every maximum clique, and the linear/complement properties from definitions; the packaged enumeration is compared exactly against the recomputed maxima.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for binary length-six single-grain codes. The older Sharov--Roth full text was not accessible during the final comparison, so an obscure unindexed extremizer census cannot be excluded.
title: Complete census of maximum length-six single-grain codes
